title: True DAAST 1.0 InLine root document for a podcast placement

source.name: AdCOM 1.0 List: Creative Subtypes - Audio/Video (9=DAAST 1.0, 10=DAAST 1.0 Wrapper) and the IAB DAAST 1.0 deprecation notice
source.version: AdCOM 1.0 FINAL public creative-subtypes registry, accessed 2026-09-07
source.notes: All source records are retained in assets/sources.json by reference.sourceIds. No primary DAAST 1.0 element-schema document is archived in this repo's sources; the InLine/AdSystem/AdTitle/Impression/Creatives/Creative/Linear/Duration/MediaFiles/MediaFile hierarchy below is authored from the publicly documented DAAST-mirrors-VAST convention (DAAST reuses VAST's InLine/Wrapper element names under its own root), not copied from a DAAST XSD or sample file.

modifications: All IDs, domains, titles and XML are original test data; no upstream DAAST document was copied.
Request/response IDs and impid are intentionally paired.
No real person, cookie, advertising ID, IP address or live tracking endpoint is retained.
provenance.sanitized: No production payload or PII used. All resource and tracking hosts end in .test; external network must remain blocked.

pairApplicability.note: Use x-openrtb-version: 2.6 when replaying HTTP; envelope itself has no version field.

specNotes: DAAST 1.0 mirrors VAST's InLine/Creatives/Linear/MediaFiles hierarchy under its own <DAAST> root, per AdCOM's List: Creative Subtypes - Audio/Video (value 9 = DAAST 1.0, value 10 = DAAST 1.0 Wrapper). The code comment elsewhere assigning value 4 to DAAST is a known documentation drift, already corrected in audio-daast-26-request-only; this fixture uses the correct 9/10 pair.

isVastShape() is anchored to the literal VAST root element name; a <DAAST> root never matches it, so validateVast() never runs against this adm. Zero vast.* findings is spec-correct here — a DAAST document is not a VAST document and must not be judged by VAST's structural rules.

Because isVastShape() also gates the response-side FORMATS.VIDEO mis-tag that afflicts VAST-rooted audio bids elsewhere in this corpus (see audio-web-25-mp3-legacy, DEF-101), a genuinely DAAST-rooted audio bid does NOT inherit that mistake: format.formats is expected to stay audio-only here.
feed 3 identifies podcast (AOD) inventory per AdCOM List: Feed Types.

This fixture only proves protocol declaration and creative-shape recognition. DAAST structural validation (an IAB-rule-equivalent of vast.*) does not exist anywhere in Core (packages/core/rules-vast.js only recognizes a <VAST> root) — a deliberately broken DAAST body would currently validate as clean, but demonstrating that requires an invalid DAAST document, which is mutation-category territory, not a base pair, and is documented here for context rather than asserted.
Current Inspector contract shows VAST/DAAST creatives as inert text; text visibility must not be counted as creative rendering or media playback.
notes: Core observations in the source archive were deliberately excluded from expectations. Protocol metadata may describe a vendor-specific 2.x carrier; it does not claim a normative minor-version inference.

preview.capabilityGap: DAAST creatives have no dedicated preview path; the contract shows them as inert markup with no DAAST-aware structural validation and no audio playback.
